assertions.claim: Hiding a major illness before registration lets the other party petition the court to annul the marriage; petition within one year of learning
assertions.cn_span: 有重大疾病没在登记前如实告诉对方，对方可以去法院请求撤销这段婚姻，撤销要在知道之日起一年内提出

assertions.claim: Since 2003 the premarital medical check is not a precondition of registration; going is voluntary
assertions.cn_span: 婚检本身自 2003 年起就不是领证的前置条件，去不去自愿

assertions.claim: Free or discounted for eligible ages in most regions; self-paid a few hundred yuan, takes half a day
assertions.cn_span: 多数地区对适龄人群免费或减免，自费也就几百元、花半天

assertions.claim: The state treats the premarital check as the first line of defense against birth defects; targets: check rate and pre-pregnancy coverage kept at 70% and 80%+
assertions.cn_span: 国家把婚检当作出生缺陷防治的第一道关口，现行目标是「婚前医学检查率、孕前优生健康检查目标人群覆盖率分别保持在 70% 和 80% 以上」

assertions.claim: Whether free and which items are tested are decided locally; ask the local maternal-and-child health institution or the one-stop window
assertions.cn_span: 是否免费、查哪些项目由各地定，去当地妇幼保健机构或婚姻登记处一站式窗口问
